* '''Printed text''' (this page): as given in the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet (official text as of 15 March 2010; the surviving copy was re-made 4 April 2010)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of March 15, 2010"; PDF dated 4 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 13)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. If opponent's [Virtual Block 6] card just added a destiny to total power or attrition here, draw two destiny, choose one, and subtract it from their attrition and total power. Your characters here are immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 3.” (the printed slip shows the pilot icon with 2). The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-25-Phylo_Gandish.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-phylogandish-pre.gif]]) print it. The PC website card list (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) shows the same text with the pilot icon written out.<ref name="cl-1263_26-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The Virtual Block 6.3 sheet came out on 12 March 2010, three days before the date it carries<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>.
* '''Advanced Rulebook 2.0''', Appendix A (Errata): “The phrase "(except battle destiny)" has been removed.”<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-16; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announcement date not found). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref> No published text with that phrase has been found (the release sheet, the card image, the card list and the Master List all lack it), so no earlier version can be shown here. The sheet came out on 12 March 2010, and the surviving re-made copy (uploaded to the Players Committee site on 3 April 2010) lacks the phrase<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref>; the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010 lacks it too<ref name="cdf-20100529-light">Players Committee Holotable card data file, “version 20100529” (lightside.cdf; card data, not a printed source), as committed on 13 July 2010 to [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf ledwards/swccgvkit] (commit 5047de0)</ref>. So if the first printing had it, it was removed between 12 March and 3 April 2010.
